title: Kanda 2: Hymns of Healing & Cosmic Harmony
summary: Sacred prayers of Shaunaka Shakha from Kanda 2.
ai_summary: Vedic hymns of health, protection, and universal peace from Kanda 2.

verses.original: वेनस्तत्पश्यत्परमं गुहा यद्यत्र विश्वं भवत्येकनीडम् । इदं पृश्निरदुहज्जायमानाः स्वर्विदो अभ्यनूषत व्राः ॥
verses.transliteration: venastatpaśyatparamaṁ guhā yadyatra viśvaṁ bhavatyekanīḍam | idaṁ pṛśniraduhajjāyamānāḥ svarvido abhyanūṣata vrāḥ ||
verses.translation: The enlightened seer Vena beheld that supreme Mystery hidden in the secret cave of the heart, wherein all this universe becomes of one single nest!

layers.author: sayana
layers.content: The sublime mystical vision of the universe as a single loving nest (Eka-nidam) within the Supreme Reality.

layers.author: whitney
